def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split at the central uniform separator column; combine matching shared-color cells.
    cut = w // 2
    left = [row[:cut] for row in grid]
    right = [row[cut + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected exactly one shared color")
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(cut)] for r in range(h)]
